description: OCR.space extracts text from images and PDFs through an HTTP API, returning JSON. It supports multiple OCR languages and image formats, table-oriented parsing, and searchable-PDF creation with Engines 1 and 2. The documented API does not provide a search/replace feature.
resolution_notes: cors: yes. On May 2, 2026, the official OCR API team confirmed that responses include Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *: https://forum.ui.vision/t/copyfish-on-edge-extension-down/29714. description: corrected. Current official documentation lists image/PDF extraction, languages, supported formats, isTable, and searchable-PDF creation, but no search/replace parameter: https://ocr.space/ocrapi.
